manifest:
[package]
name = "open_pipe_stress_viewport_editor"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Viewport editor command-intent support for OpenPipeStress"
publish = false

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]

[package]
name = "open_pipe_stress_library_import_document"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Library-import provenance seam: runtime validation of material/section/component library import payloads (required provenance, redistribution/review disposition, protected-content quarantine, unit and value-level provenance) projected into the PKG-02 import-boundary diagnostic envelope. Runtime Rust port of the DEL-03-07 provenance-checker contract (core/library_import/provenance_checker.py). No external file-format parsing, no legal license determinations, no professional, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance claims."

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

[package]
name = "open_pipe_stress_load_case_algebra"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Code-neutral load case algebra for OpenPipeStress"
publish = false

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
open_pipe_stress_primitive_loads = { path = "../primitive_loads" }

[package]
name = "open_pipe_stress_primitive_loads"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Code-neutral primitive load case mechanics for OpenPipeStress"
publish = false

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
open_pipe_stress_frame_kernel = { path = "../../solver/frame_kernel" }
open_pipe_stress_linear_supports = { path = "../../solver/linear_supports" }

[package]
name = "open_pipe_stress_self_weight_wasm"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Original-document authenticated self-weight operation draft adapter"
publish = false

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[features]
default = []
wasm = ["dep:wasm-bindgen"]

[dependencies]
open_pipe_stress_product_physics = { path = "../../product_physics" }
open_pipe_stress_canonical_json = { path = "../../serialization/canonical_json" }
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "0.10"
wasm-bindgen = { version = "=0.2.123", optional = true }

[package]
name = "open_pipe_stress_stress_recovery"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Code-neutral mechanics stress recovery for OpenPipeStress"
publish = false

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
open_pipe_stress_primitive_loads = { path = "../primitive_loads" }
open_pipe_stress_straight_pipe = { path = "../../solver/straight_pipe" }

[package]
name = "open_pipe_stress_user_loads"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Code-neutral concentrated and distributed user load application for OpenPipeStress"
publish = false

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
open_pipe_stress_frame_kernel = { path = "../../solver/frame_kernel" }
open_pipe_stress_primitive_loads = { path = "../primitive_loads" }
open_pipe_stress_straight_pipe = { path = "../../solver/straight_pipe" }

[package]
name = "open_pipe_stress_operation_applier"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Structured editor-operation validation, diff preview, and apply seam for OpenPipeStress model documents"
publish = false

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"
# `cdylib` exists for the feature-gated wasm32 browser engine build; `rlib`
# keeps the native library/test path unchanged.
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[features]
# Browser-engine build (DEC-020 / ADR-0001): wasm-bindgen JSON-string exports.
# Native builds and tests never enable this feature.
wasm = ["dep:wasm-bindgen"]

[dependencies]
# RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON text — the single canonicalization for every
# hash seam (completion-plan H5); this crate re-exports its `canonical_json`.
open_pipe_stress_canonical_json = { path = "../../serialization/canonical_json" }
open_pipe_stress_units = { path = "../../units" }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "0.10"
# Pinned exactly: the wasm-bindgen CLI version must match the crate version
# (see docs/BUILD_AND_RELEASE.md and apps/desktop wasm build script).
wasm-bindgen = { version = "=0.2.123", optional = true }

[package]
name = "open_pipe_stress_audit_manifest"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Audit manifest and model hash support for OpenPipeStress"
publish = false

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]

[package]
name = "open_pipe_stress_pdf_emitter"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Hash-bound deterministic PDF emitter and full-report-package assembly for OpenPipeStress (DEC-061)"
publish = false

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
open_pipe_stress_report_renderer = { path = "../report_renderer" }
open_pipe_stress_report_generator = { path = "../report_generator", features = ["serde"] }
open_pipe_stress_report_sections = { path = "../report_sections", features = ["serde"] }
open_pipe_stress_protected_content_linter = { path = "../protected_content_linter" }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
sha2 = "0.10"

[dev-dependencies]
serde_json = "1"

[package]

[dependencies]
# RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON text — the single canonicalization for every
# OpenPipeStress hash seam (completion-plan hardening row H5).
open_pipe_stress_canonical_json = { path = "../../serialization/canonical_json" }
open_pipe_stress_product_physics = { path = "../../product_physics" }
open_pipe_stress_report_package = { path = "../../reporting/report_package" }
# DEL-08-04 result-export vocabulary, consumed read-only through its public
# API by the governed analysis-run producer binding (R14 W1 T1).
open_pipe_stress_result_export = { path = "../../reporting/result_export" }
# DEL-10-05 benchmark/regression payload bindings (CB-2026-07-19-DEL-10-05-
# RUNNER-PAYLOADS-001): the suite crates remain the single source of fixture
# identity, recorded comparison values, and encoded comparison predicates.
open_pipe_stress_mechanics_benchmarks = { path = "../../../validation/benchmarks/mechanics" }
open_pipe_stress_stress_benchmarks = { path = "../../../validation/benchmarks/stress" }
open_pipe_stress_nonlinear_benchmarks = { path = "../../../validation/benchmarks/nonlinear" }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "0.10"

name = "open_pipe_stress_canonical_json"

[dependencies]

# Digit source for ECMAScript-equal shortest round-trip rendering (closest

# Already in the dependency closure: serde_json formats floats through ryu.
